review_text: I expected a dull drama, yet the final act is moving and memorable.
The camera work is stylish but the story never becomes convincing.
Far from terrible: the dialogues are sharp and the performances are warm.
The movie starts well and then collapses into a tedious final hour.
A playful, inventive film that made me smile throughout.
Not a good sequel. The jokes feel forced and the characters are flat.
